scientific_integrity: The finite recurrences, Laplace expression, weak-rate boundary and two-scale limits are supported by a constructive analytic proof plus independent exact-rational program comparisons. No independent external scientific audit or validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Irreversible edge-arrival dimer adsorption on two complete graphs linked by exactly one bridge; graph orders at least 2 and all positive real bridge rates. Unequal-clique asymptotics require a positive finite size ratio. Older 1989 and 1991 primary full texts were inaccessible and historical priority is provisional.
title: A parity-sensitive weak-link law for irreversible dimers on clique barbells
